evidence.applicability: 查证 Node.insertBefore 标准规范，证实其在现代浏览器全平台普遍支持（Baseline: Widely available since 2015），支持在清空回滚或 DOM 异常恢复时，将原输入节点准确插回原父节点及 nextSibling 位置，保障唯一输入框与 DOM 拓扑原子恢复。
evidence.content: Node: insertBefore() method - Web APIs | MDN: The insertBefore() method of the Node interface inserts a node before a reference node as a child of a specified parent node. If referenceNode is null, newNode is inserted at the end of node's child nodes. If the given node already exists in the document, it is moved from its current position. Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).

evidence.applicability: 查证 HTMLTextAreaElement.readOnly 属性规范，证实其支持在用户不可修改的同时仍可点击和选中（unlike disabled），支撑在严重回插失败等极端回滚异常时，采用只读 textarea 呈现已捕获的用户草稿全文，允许用户点击并手动选中复制，且纯文本 value 赋值杜绝 HTML 注入，无需剪贴板权限或外部存储。
evidence.content: HTMLTextAreaElement: readOnly property - Web APIs | MDN: The readOnly property of the HTMLTextAreaElement interface indicates that the user cannot modify the value of the control. Unlike the disabled attribute, the readonly attribute does not prevent the user from clicking or selecting in the control. Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).

evidence.applicability: 查证 Element.compositionend 标准事件规范，证实其在输入法会话完成或取消时触发（如中文拼音输入），并提供 generated characters（event.data）。在清空重置时需结合节点闭包与代际隔离，防止旧会话的迟到 compositionend 污染新输入或触发伪空值校验。
evidence.content: Element: compositionend event - Web APIs | MDN: The compositionend event is fired when a text composition system such as an input method editor completes or cancels the current composition session (e.g., after entering a Chinese character via Pinyin IME). Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).

evidence.applicability: 证实 InputEvent.isComposing 为只读布尔属性，指示 input 事件是否发生在 compositionstart 与 compositionend 之间；在 300ms 自动展示逻辑中用于过滤拼音组合输入中的临时拼音字符，仅在非组合态或 compositionend 提交后才调度防抖展示。
evidence.content: InputEvent: isComposing property - Web APIs | MDN: The InputEvent.isComposing read-only property returns a boolean value indicating if the event is fired after compositionstart and before compositionend. Baseline: Widely available.

summary: 本任务完成了对技术栈与清空状态事务关键 Web 标准 API（Node.insertBefore, HTMLTextAreaElement.readOnly, Element: compositionend, InputEvent.isComposing）的官方规范查证，并记录了实际来源与原始哈希。查证证实：1. Node.insertBefore 获得全平台基准支持，支持在清空回滚或 DOM 异常恢复时将原输入框精准插回原拓扑位置，确保单输入框与 ID 唯一性；2. HTMLTextAreaElement.readOnly 允许用户选中并手动复制文本，支撑严重回插失败时的只读全文草稿兜底呈现；3. CompositionEvent 与 isComposing 明确了中文输入法组合态生命周期，支持节点闭包代际隔离以消除尾随事件竞态；4. 受控实验环境因宿主机 Docker 守护进程未启动而如实标记为 unexecuted，不冒充已实测；5. 发现 blk-tech-module 与 blk-tech-interface 存在事务递增顺序冲突及公共接口初始化装配契约缺失问题，已作为 blockers 提出供后续整合任务处理。
